track_ddl.description: Enable or disable tracking of DDL (data definition language) changes such as CREATE, ALTER, DROP.

track_function_usage.description: Enable or disable tracking of function calls (when functions are executed).

track_planning_usage.description: Enable or disable tracking of query planning statistics (e.g., planning time).

track_utilization.description: Enable or disable tracking of resource utilization (e.g., CPU, I/O) per query.

track_locks.description: Enable or disable tracking of lock events (e.g., lock acquisition, wait times).

track_wal.description: Enable or disable tracking of Write-Ahead Log (WAL) activity.

track_io_timing.description: Enable or disable tracking of I/O timing statistics (requires track_io_timing = on in PostgreSQL).

track_locks_mode.description: Scope of lock tracking: 'per_database', 'per_table', or 'none' to disable.

track_function_usage_mode.description: Scope of function usage tracking: 'per_function', 'per_schema', or 'none' to disable.

track_planning_usage_mode.description: Scope of planning usage tracking: 'per_query', 'per_plan', or 'none' to disable.

track_utilization_mode.description: Scope of utilization tracking: 'per_query', 'per_backend', or 'none' to disable.

track_wal_mode.description: Scope of WAL tracking: 'per_database' or 'none' to disable.

track_io_timing_mode.description: Scope of I/O timing tracking: 'per_query' or 'none' to disable.

track_ddl_schema.description: Schema name where DDL tracking tables are created.

track_ddl_table.description: Table name for DDL tracking events.

track_function_usage_schema.description: Schema name where function usage tracking tables are created.

track_function_usage_table.description: Table name for function usage tracking events.

track_planning_usage_schema.description: Schema name where planning usage tracking tables are created.

track_planning_usage_table.description: Table name for planning usage tracking events.

track_utilization_schema.description: Schema name where utilization tracking tables are created.

track_utilization_table.description: Table name for utilization tracking events.

track_locks_schema.description: Schema name where locks tracking tables are created.

track_locks_table.description: Table name for locks tracking events.

track_wal_schema.description: Schema name where WAL tracking tables are created.

track_wal_table.description: Table name for WAL tracking events.

track_io_timing_schema.description: Schema name where I/O timing tracking tables are created.

track_io_timing_table.description: Table name for I/O timing tracking events.

track_ddl_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain DDL tracking records before cleanup.

track_function_usage_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain function usage tracking records before cleanup.

track_planning_usage_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain planning usage tracking records before cleanup.

track_utilization_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain utilization tracking records before cleanup.

track_locks_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain locks tracking records before cleanup.

track_wal_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain WAL tracking records before cleanup.

track_io_timing_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain I/O timing tracking records before cleanup.

excluded_tables.description: List of tables (schema.table) to exclude from tracking. Useful to skip high-churn or internal tables.

schema_name.description: Schema name of the excluded table.

excluded_functions.description: List of functions (schema.function) to exclude from function usage tracking.

schema_name.description: Schema name of the excluded function.
